title: Prepare for travel
simplified_paragraphs: 下个月我想去旅游，但是还没想好去哪儿。朋友觉得北方好玩，但是下个月北方太冷了，南方好一些，不冷也不热。旅游的时候水果、面包、手机、电脑、地图，我都想带去。朋友说应该少带一些东西，因为这是旅游，不是搬家。但是我还是想多带一些衣服，这样每天都可以穿漂亮的衣服照相。
traditional_paragraphs: 下個月我想去旅遊，但是還沒想好去哪兒。朋友覺得北方好玩，但是下個月北方太冷了，南方好一些，不冷也不熱。旅遊的時候水果、麵包、手機、電腦、地圖，我都想帶去。朋友說應該少帶一些東西，因為這是旅遊，不是搬家。但是我還是想多帶一些衣服，這樣每天都可以穿漂亮的衣服照相。
pinyin_paragraphs: xià gè yuè wǒ xiǎng qù lǚ yóu， dàn shì hái méi xiǎng hǎo qù nǎ r。 péng you jué de běi fāng hǎo wán， dàn shì xià gè yuè běi fāng tài lěng le， nán fāng hǎo yī xiē， bù lěng yě bù rè。 lǚ yóu de shí hou shuǐ guǒ、 miàn bāo、 shǒu jī、 diàn nǎo、 dì tú， wǒ dōu xiǎng dài qù。 péng you shuō yīng gāi shǎo dài yī xiē dōng xi， yīn wèi zhè shì lǚ yóu， bù shì bān jiā。 dàn shì wǒ hái shi xiǎng duō dài yī xiē yī fu， zhè yàng měi tiān dōu kě yǐ chuān piào liang de yī fu zhào xiàng。
english_paragraphs: I want to travel next month, but I haven’t decided where to go yet. My friend thinks the north is fun, but it will be too cold next month. The south is better, neither cold nor hot. When I travel, I want to take fruits, bread, mobile phones, computers, and maps with me. My friend said that I should bring less stuff with me because this is a trip, not a move. But I still want to bring more clothes so that I can wear beautiful clothes and take photos every day.
english_full: I want to travel next month, but I haven’t decided where to go yet. My friend thinks the north is fun, but it will be too cold next month. The south is better, neither cold nor hot. When I travel, I want to take fruits, bread, mobile phones, computers, and maps with me. My friend said that I should bring less stuff with me because this is a trip, not a move. But I still want to bring more clothes so that I can wear beautiful clothes and take photos every day.
